messages:
Mia Chen: Morning — quick smokecheck from me: finished eval pass for s-7b-lite, saw ~2% regression on the 'summarize' promptset (esp. Spanish examples). Opened PR: https://git.redwood/example/pr/4921. Anyone else seeing similar dips?
Jordan Patel: :eyes: looking now. Did you run with quantized weights or full-precision?
Mia Chen: Ran with Q4 int8. Baseline full-precision looks fine locally. Suspect tokenization or preprocessing quirk for some Spanish inputs. Pasting one failing case below.
Mia Chen: ```
input: "Resumen: ¿Cuál es el objetivo principal de la compañía?"
expected: "La misión es..."
actual: "La misión es \u0000"
```
Samir Gomez: I can repro locally with the same sample. Seen similar when KV cache warmup misaligns after batching. Which runtime commit are you on?
Mia Chen: runtime @ 7f3b9c (latest). Batching policy = 'adaptive-small', batch max = 8.
Priya Rao: Heads up I'm OOO after 2pm but can review PR before that. @Jordan can you scan eval noise types? If it's tokenization we should add a normalization step in the prompt pipeline.
Jordan Patel: On it. Quick ping @deploy-bot — any canary running for s-7b-lite right now?
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary s-7b-lite running in us-west-2 (3/3 healthy). Canary tag: canary-2026-03-17-09
Ava (intern): Added a tiny preprocessing patch on branch `fix/tokenize-normalize`. Tests pass locally (unit). Link: https://git.redwood/example/branch/fix-tokenize
Samir Gomez: Nice. Can you add a pytest case with that Spanish sample? I'll queue a targeted eval once it's in.
Mia Chen: Queued a full promptset eval against 'summarize-es-v2' — ETA ~18m. If regression persists we'll prepare a rollback plan.
Jordan Patel: :thumbsup: If we rollback, which model variant is the fallback?
Priya Rao: Fallback plan: route traffic to s-7b-stable (pre-quant) — fastest to flip. Ops can apply routing override.
Mia Chen: Thanks — will post results after first eval completes. Small blocker: need a quick CR on PR before I can merge. @Priya @Jordan please prioritize if you can.
Priya Rao: I'll review in ~20m.
Jordan Patel: Reviewing now, one minor nit about whitespace in the normalizer.
Mia Chen: Fixed and pushed. Also note: there is a flaky example in the eval set (index 432) that was causing noise; Samir flagged to ignore for this run.
Samir Gomez: Yep I added it to the ignore list for eval #3421.
deploy-bot: eval-bot: Eval run #3421 started on s-7b-lite against promptset 'summarize-es-v2'. ETA ~17m.
Mia Chen: Great — thanks. Quick logistical note: pairing session today 10:30am for new model owners onboarding (covering eval creation + promptset hygiene). Drop by if you can.
Ava (intern): I'll join and bring a short demo on creating stable prompt tests.
Mia Chen: Sweet. Will update here with pass/fail. If it fails badly we'll trigger routing override and open an incident ticket.
Jordan Patel: Keeping an eye.
Priya Rao: If you need me to cut the routing override, ping and I'll action it.
Mia Chen: Thanks all, will report back in ~20.
